skills.description: Peter Drucker's The Essential Drucker — an executable toolkit that applies Drucker's six decades of management wisdom: the five deadly business sins, management by objectives, innovation, the knowledge worker, the effective executive, and leading change. Related skills: the-servant (leadership), 7-habits (personal effectiveness), leadership-in-turbulent-times (crisis leadership).
